A web search for a printed text (Memoires de Nevers 1665) found nothing in the hour. f. 209 demoted to decoded, not read; no document reads; class read in part -> not read, method -> not solved, fraction_read 0.311 -> 0.

texts.label: Nevers to Pisany, 8 Sept 1593, BnF fr. 3985 f. 209 (copy)
texts.summary: During his embassy to Rome for Henri IV's absolution, Nevers writes to Pisany that people were dissuading the King from seeking the Pope's absolution, that he (Nevers) argued there was no need for him to go without it, and that if there is no will to satisfy the Pope one should not go at all.
texts.note: Decoded, not read (v3 check 23 Oct 2026): the three cipher passages, cut out of texts/f209_reading.md (which mixes figures, decode and commentary), score 0.33 on explicit holes (1 of 3 sentences), 0.0 plain, hole rate 0.16. Passage 2 holds ('[Duc de Nevers] alleguoit qu'il n'estoyt besoin qu'il a[l]la[s]t sans cela, parce qu'il ne feroit rien [...] de [Revol]'); passages 1 and 3 rest on supplied letters and on figures the copyist got wrong (don[n]es[t], l'absolutio[n], 99 Pape where Roy is expected; 11 for u, 14 inside 'de', 57 83 84 for 'y a i'). The figures of passage 1 were checked again on the IIIF image (canvas 419) and match the transcription. The copy is the only witness: no original, decipherment or edition found. Keeps its partial reading.

texts.label: Nevers to Pisany, 14 Oct 1593, BnF fr. 3986 f. 168 (copy)
texts.note: Re-read 22 Oct 2026 (texts/f168_reread_log.md): figures re-read on the IIIF image, 14 corrections (bars mis-assigned, segmentation; ct_3986_f168_r2.txt). Lines 1-3 and 6-7 now read as sentences ("Je luy ay demandé come [...] le Pape voloit que j'y alase; elle m'a dit n'avoir autre charge, ne me declarans que j'y alle ou non"; "Ce qu'il faict tenir segret, et le faire savoir a [Gondi]"); lines 4, 5 and the last line keep holes (about half the sentences hold; _check_reading 0.30 on the reading text). Blocker: the figures are legible but the register copy is corrupt there (dropped and swapped figures, 24 for 34, 27 for 29), and there is no second witness (no decipherment, original or edition) to restore them.
texts.summary: Written the day after Possevino's message at Poschiavo: the Duke of Nevers will not be received as ambassador for several reasons; Nevers reports what he was told and his intention to advance and do as he was written, with Cardinal Gondi and the Duke of Mantua named. Read in long stretches; several passages remain garbled by the copyist's figures.
